portInfo.description: Turkish port city on the Aegean coast, known for its ancient history, vibrant bazaar, and seaside promenade.

gettingThere.walkingTime: 15-25 minutes to Konak Square—confirm on your sailing programme before you rely on a fixed walk time.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Alsancak Kordon — waterfront immediately tied to the port address.
Ephesus (UNESCO) — only with a timed excursion and confirmed all-aboard.
Konak / Agora — gap: no usable primary venue page captured; do not pad with catalog blurbs.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Alsancak looks walkable; Ephesus is not. Treat “İzmir call” and “Ephesus day” as different plans.
